cd /app/tmp/work && cat > stress4.py <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, time, sys, random, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
rng = random.Random(17)
N = 20
fields = [{"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"} for i in range(N)]
atoms = [{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f%d"%i,"at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}} for i in range(N)]
triples = list(itertools.combinations(range(N),3))
def row(false_set):
    return [ (i in false_set) is False for i in range(N) ]
train = []
for s in range(2):
    rows = [{"t":k,"values":row(t)} for k,t in enumerate(triples)]
    train.append({"id":"tr%d"%s,"source":"s%d"%s,"rows":rows})
probe_rows = []
for k in range(128):
    fs = set(rng.sample(range(N),10))
    probe_rows.append({"t":k,"values":row(fs)})
probes=[{"id":"pr0","source":"s0","rows":probe_rows}]
qrows=[]
for k in range(1024):
    fs = set(rng.sample(range(N),rng.randint(0,10)))
    qrows.append({"t":k,"values":row(fs)})
queries=[{"id":"q0","source":"s0","rows":qrows}]
req={"version":1,"window":1,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,
     "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
     "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}
text=json.dumps(req)
print('input bytes',len(text),'train ctx',2*len(triples))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=text.encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
el=time.time()-t0
out=p.stdout
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%el,'stdout bytes',len(out))
r=json.loads(out.decode())
if 'error' in r: print(r)
else:
    from collections import Counter
    print('classes',len(r['classes']),'members total',sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes']))
    print(Counter(q['status'] for q in r['queries']))
    print('sig width', len(r['classes'][0]['signature']))
print(p.stderr.decode()[:300])
EOF
